Title: Vampirism
Description:
Become a beast of the night with Vampirism, a one point physical mutation.
You will never die from thirst, but being thirsty as a vampire can be much more dangerous than being thirsty as a human.

[h1]Wiki TL:DR[/h1]
-Drink blood instead of water.
-Feed ability: stun w/ good damage and healing. Player Level + Agility or vampirism level (whichever is higher) increases hit chance.
-Stealth: Sneak attack that automatically hits. Works if there are "no witnesses" or on the specified "one witness"
-Humanity: Draining neutral people or companions to death will reduce humanity. Can view humanity score and regen time in Effects tab.
-Frenzy: Freak out and lose control if you are too thirsty. Automatically attack the first living thing you see.
-Wight: At 0 humanity, you lose control of your predatory urges, and will frenzy at the first sight of any living creature. Humanity no longer regenerates.

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
- Sometimes, autocollect blood does not work. You can fix this by saving/loading the game, until I solve the problem.
- If you are using [b]Nightbeast[/b] and you save/load on the overworld map during the day, then the time will NOT automatically advance to night and you will get fried when you exit the map. You can prevent this by walking at least a single tile.

[h1]Wishes[/h1]
"humanity" to restore Humanity to max and remove Wight.
"vitae" to restore blood to maximum.
"bloodlust" sets blood value to 0.
"frenzy" makes you frenzy.
"wassail" turns you into a Wight.
"bloodpack" puts a blood canteen in your inventory.

[b]Special thanks to _Cell for providing a fix for a critical bug in the Humanity system.[/b]


[b]Compatibility[/b]:
Avoid modded mutations that add new bodyparts to your face or that involve drinking water.
